recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future event-pattern changes should use current resource-specific Jira tickets and, for DeviceUsage/SupplyRequest/SupplyDelivery, the owning OO Incubator or extension-pack source rather than broad edits under the old FHIR-10299 umbrella.
issue_request: FHIR-10299 requested that the then-current Supply, Alert, Observation, DeviceUseStatement, and DiagnosticReport event-resource data elements align with the event resource template. It was Published/Persuasive for DSTU2, with a final Jira comment saying remaining workflow-pattern tasks were consolidated into GF#19631.
initial_application: Historical commits 5a6e321c64, aa45786302, a61742ca1c, and 1639b8d104 explicitly mention #10299/GF#10299 and changed event-pattern extensions plus SupplyDelivery, DeviceUseStatement, DiagnosticReport, Observation, and status-code source. A Zulip #committers close-out thread also records GF#10299 being marked applied with remaining workflow work moved to GF#19631.
additional_context: Current fhir.ini registers Observation, DiagnosticReport, and Flag; records Alert and Supply as removed; and has no active DeviceUsage, DeviceUseStatement, SupplyDelivery, or SupplyRequest resource entries. The current workflow page links DeviceUsage, SupplyRequest, and SupplyDelivery to the OO Incubator. Later resource-specific decisions already handle current workflow alignment: FHIR-43456 for Observation, FHIR-43443 and FHIR-50597 for DiagnosticReport, FHIR-43452 for SupplyDelivery, FHIR-51713 for DeviceUsage, and FHIR-19631 for the remaining OO workflow umbrella. Event-pattern guidance also permits reviewed domain-specific omissions and deviations.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current active Observation and DiagnosticReport StructureDefinitions map to Event and contain the relevant Event workflow mappings; Flag is not listed as an Event resource; and the old Supply, Alert, and DeviceUseStatement/SupplyDelivery surfaces are removed, renamed, or externalized from active core build scope.
